projects.name: PoliCast
projects.description: An interactive podcast generation platform that synthesizes complex political whitepapers and bills into engaging, multi-speaker conversational audio using LLMs and advanced Text-to-Speech (TTS). Implemented real-time response streaming via Server-Sent Events (SSE) for instant generation feedback.
bullets: Architected an SSE streaming pipeline to deliver real-time podcast scripts and audio chunks dynamically.
Implemented vector embeddings to cross-reference speaker scripts with original policy documents, eliminating hallucinations.
Designed a glassmorphic dashboard built using Vanilla CSS for smooth, responsive user interactions.

projects.name: URL Shortener
projects.tagline: High-throughput URL shortener with real-time analytics
projects.description: A high-performance URL shortener built with engineering restraint, featuring real-time click tracking, geolocation analytics, and user agent parsing.
bullets: Designed a highly efficient hashing algorithm to generate short aliases with zero collision risk.
Created an in-memory caching layer to handle up to 10k redirects/second with sub-10ms response times.
Integrated a real-time analytics dashboard displaying visitor metrics and click referrers.

projects.name: Wildfire CNN
projects.tagline: Convolutional Neural Network for early wildfire detection
projects.description: A deep learning computer vision model designed to detect active wildfires and smoke plumes from satellite and aerial imagery.
bullets: Trained a custom CNN architecture reaching 96.7% classification accuracy on test imagery datasets.
Optimized the model weight sizes via quantization for deployment on edge devices and drones.
Built a map-based visualization interface plotting simulated fire boundaries and prediction heatmaps.

projects.name: Sanskrit OCR
projects.tagline: Optical Character Recognition system for historical Sanskrit manuscripts
projects.description: A specialized OCR engine fine-tuned to parse Devnagari script and Sanskrit ligatures from scanned historical documents.
bullets: Fine-tuned a Vision-Encoder-Decoder model to handle complex ligature combinations and degraded paper conditions.
Implemented post-processing linguistic filters using Sanskrit corpora to correct common OCR spelling errors.
Exposed an API endpoint for batch document ingestion and structural markdown conversion.
